text: Sorry if this is a silly one. I'm a foster carer and I've had this little girl, she's 5 months, for a few weeks now, so I'm still learning what's normal for her and I don't want to overreact. She's had a temperature tonight, I took it a little while ago and it was 38.7. That part I could probably handle, but she's got some little spots on her tummy and one leg. They're tiny dark reddish dots, a couple look a bit purple. I remembered something about pressing a glass on them, so I tried it with a tumbler and I could still see them clearly through the glass. They didn't go away at all. I might be doing it wrong, I honestly don't know. The other thing that's confusing me is that she has a fever but her hands and feet feel really cold, like icy, and she keeps shivering even with a blanket on. I thought a fever meant hot? I've put socks on her. Her social worker isn't reachable this late and I didn't want to wake anyone over nothing, but it's been bugging me enough that I thought I'd better message. It's probably fine but I'd rather someone told me that.
